title: Cisco ISE 802.1X Certificate Authentication for Wi-Fi & Wired via Intune
hook: Certificate-authenticate every device onto Wi-Fi and wired with Cisco ISE
problem: Pre-shared Wi-Fi keys and open switch ports are an open door. 802.1X with certificates makes every device prove identity before it touches the network — but delivering the certs and Wi-Fi/wired profiles to a fleet is the hard part. This solution issues certificates from Intune and deploys the Wi-Fi and wired 802.1X profiles that authenticate to Cisco ISE over EAP-TLS — the on-prem NAC counterpart to certificate VPN, deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — how 802.1X / EAP-TLS works for Wi-Fi and wired with ISE as the RADIUS authority, the certificate + network-profile model, and where Intune delivery meets the Cisco switching/wireless infrastructure.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (a CA / Cloud PKI, Intune SCEP/PKCS + trusted-root profiles, Wi-Fi/wired 802.1X profile settings, ISE policy for EAP-TLS, Entra groups, a pilot group) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps to deploy the certificate and trusted-root profiles, build the Wi-Fi and wired 802.1X device profiles in Intune, assign to a named pilot group, validate ISE authenticates the device, then expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — 802.1X readiness discovery, per-device certificate + network-profile validation, a Wi-Fi/wired profile coverage report, safe remediation of missing profiles/certs, and a target-group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates (cert present, profile applied, ISE 802.1X auth success), plus Best Practices for supplicant and renewal.
short: Issue certificates from Intune and deploy Wi-Fi and wired 802.1X profiles that authenticate to Cisco ISE over EAP-TLS — on-prem NAC for every device, deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: Issue certificates from Intune and deploy Wi-Fi and wired 802.1X profiles that authenticate to Cisco ISE over EAP-TLS — on-prem NAC for every device, pilot-first.
meta_title: Cisco ISE 802.1X Certificate Authentication for Wi-Fi & Wired via Intune

bottom_line: Every device certificate-authenticated onto Wi-Fi and wired by Cisco ISE — profiles and certs delivered from Intune, and proven on a pilot before you scale.
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (Cisco ISE / Secure Client + Intune integration; certificate/posture/network-profile work, live-access risk).

Cisco ISE and Cisco Secure Client (AnyConnect) console/profile-editor internals are deferred to Cisco's official documentation (no fabricated menus); the Intune, Entra, and certificate side is authored at exact click-by-click detail.
